response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in routing, navigation, or distributed data pipelines — critical for this role. His DLang and Node.js work shows systems-level capability, but the absence of proven expertise in routing tile generation, real-time traffic integration, or low-latency geospatial data processing raises significant gaps.
strengths: Built and maintained open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Demonstrated systems-level programming with DLang, asynchronous I/O, and low-latency systems
Strong track record of cross-stack adaptability and technical teaching/mentorship
concerns: No explicit C++ or Rust experience in commercial routing, navigation, or geospatial data pipelines
Lack of demonstrated experience with fault-tolerant distributed systems for global routing data
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not aligned with C++ as primary requirement
